{{Otheruses|Winter}}
{{Quote|Even Gethzerion gave gifts to me during Winterfest. We cast her out of our clan only seven years ago.|[[Teneniel Djo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="CoPL" />}}
'''Winterfest''' was a holiday observed<ref name="CoPL" /> [[Standard year/Legends|annually]]<ref name="SWG">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66709&resource=features|text=Friday Feature - Holiday Player Events Guide}}</ref> among the [[Witches of Dathomir|Daughters of Allya]], the famed [[Witch/Legends|witches]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. During Winterfest, the younger witches received gifts from the elder ones.<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> Those in [[the galaxy]] who were not Daughters of Allya didn't understand how they celebrated the holiday. Individuals would use the creepiness of the witches to throw their own parties, with some claiming that they came from the lineage of the Daughters of Allya.<ref name="SWG" /> Sometime between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="SWG Date">{{GalaxiesAED}} dates itself to right after {{Film|IV}}. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the end of ''A New Hope'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. On the final day of the game's availability, players could watch the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] get [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destroyed]] from the surface of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. ''The New Essential Chronology'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}}, in which the Battle of Endor is depicted, to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Thus, [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] and all tie-in material must take place sometime between 0 ABY and 4 ABY. {{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66709&resource=features|text=Friday Feature - Holiday Player Events Guide}} states that a year prior to the game, the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] raided a village. Thus this event could've taken place anytime between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and 4 ABY.</ref> the Nightsisters traveled offworld to raid popular [[City/Legends|cities]] across the galaxy. The following year, people speculated that they would attack again.<ref name="SWG" /> Before [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> [[Teneniel Djo]] was given Winterfest gifts by her [[Djo family|aunt]] [[Gethzerion]].<ref name="CoPL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Winterfest was first mentioned in ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', a book written by [[Dave Wolverton]] and released in [[1994]].<ref name="CoPL" />
